In-person appointment inspection (remote or picture inspections ended July 1, 2022)

resale_co.notes: Hawthorne's resale certificate is one combined Fire Prevention Bureau certificate: the Continued Certificate of Compliance (Transfer of Ownership) and the state smoke detector and carbon monoxide alarm certificate are on the same application and fee, so the fees are repeated under fire_cert and paid once. The Building Department page calls it the Certificate of Continuing Compliance ('COO'). The application form says the attic and basement are not approved as sleeping rooms or separate units unless noted, and the certificate can be revoked for unpaid Borough fines or restitution. The form header phone (973-427-4889) is the Building Department / Fire Prevention office main number listed on the Building page; the Fire Prevention page lists the clerk at 973-427-7544. Rentals are separate: landlords of non owner-occupied 1-2 unit rentals must register with the Borough Clerk, and rental smoke certificates are $30 per unit without inspection or $40 with inspection. Emails are taken from the mailto links on the Borough pages.

requirements: Smoke detector on every level of the home
Carbon monoxide alarm within 10 feet of each sleeping room
Portable fire extinguisher no longer required as of February 15, 2025 (per the Fire Prevention page)
